SECTION 1. Tide 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Muld-
Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-H in the area bounded by:

              A line 290.03 feet west of and parallel to South Hoyne Avenue; West 18"^ Street; a

to those of a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District.
